[size=5][b][color=#ffff00]     [/color][u][color=#00ff00]MOD DETAILS[/color][/u][/b]
[/size]
[color=#ffff00]This mod adds a Fermentation Tank, which will process beers, sparkling wines, ciders, sakés, etc.[/color]

[color=#ffff00]This mod adds 5 crops and 2 trees.  Compatibility is already built in for other mods which add the same crops.[/color][/b]
